requirement: A conversation's model is decided once — the customer's connected plan in the desktop app, else Tracy's — never falls back mid-conversation, and plan routes never reach a shared host

oracle.invariant: S1: clean TAP; passes: no customerRoutes → default and credentials unread; a new conversation takes the connected plan, else the default; decided once (connecting later does not move a running conversation); a plan gone mid-conversation fails with tracy/plan-disconnected and never runs on the default; a logged route survives a restart; the model door accepts only the conversation's own model. S2: clean TAP; passes: connecting on → settings + config-editor on, dsh-subscriptions limited to the allowed vendors, routes in that order, authorization and ui-settings-models untouched; connecting off / no vendor / unreadable → no patch; a server that does not answer → the last copy kept, else nothing. S3: clean TAP; `customerRoutes` on tracy-mode-picker (as a row or an insert) is red in the fleet patch, the native bundle and the cowork bundle.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
